name: Lowland-Born Heir, Rinamuntaw
flavor: Born after the waters withdrew, he inherited the promise of returning lands.

name: Receding-Sea Heiress, Rinayung
flavor: Her first horizon appeared where the frightened sea had once ruled.

name: Many-Limbed Tidal Horror, Kurita
flavor: Sea and mountain fed its hunger until Juru Pakal found its flesh.

name: Mountain-Breaking Devourer, Tarabusaw
flavor: It broke the forest into weapons, yet could not break his resolve.

name: Cave-Light Heiress, Bai Amina
flavor: From the deepest refuge, she witnessed the first light of a restored world.

name: Last Refuge Chief, Datu Karim
flavor: While monsters ruled the mountains, he kept the final community alive.

name: Hollow-Tree Emberkeeper, Harun
flavor: Beside Salima, he guarded one ember until the darkness finally lifted.

name: Lost-Ring Bearer, Buganga
flavor: A lost royal ring crossed the flood within the humblest bearer.

name: Legend-Script Guardian, Datu Kali Adam
flavor: He guarded the old account so another age could hear Mindanao speak.

name: Mantapuli Memory Keeper, Alad
flavor: Age dimmed his eyes, but not the city preserved within his memory.

name: Many-Bodied Hunter, Omaka-an Shard
flavor: Every careless cut gave the devourer another mouth.

name: Bita Eclipse Hatchling, Pahira
flavor: The shell was large as a house; the shadow within was still growing.

name: Dread-Night Caller, Balbal
flavor: Its cry crossed the dark, and every hidden survivor held their breath.

name: Heaven-Sheltered Survivor, Lanao Sprite
flavor: Mercy changed the hunted into spirits the dragons could not devour.

name: Three-Scourge Slayer, Sulayman
flavor: Three monsters fell before him; the third carried him into death.

name: Sun-Darkening Scourge, Pah
text:
[blue][Persona]: [Cost: Offer 2 of your units] This unit gets Power +5000 until end of turn. If you have 1 or fewer Barriers, +10000 instead.
[green][Garahana][Persona]: After this unit attacks, [Cost: Offer 3 of your units] charge this unit and it gets Power +5000 until end of turn.
flavor: Day became night whenever its wings crossed Mount Bita.

name: Land-Restoring Raja, Indarapatra
flavor: He crossed the heavens for one brother and restored a wounded land.

name: Seven-Sight Final Scourge, Gurayan
flavor: Seven gazes watched every road, but none could turn aside the returning king.

name: Gurayen Wrath-Mate, Maka-Ogis
flavor: When Omaka-an fell, Gurayen awakened beneath her answering wrath.

name: Ridge-Bed Devourer, Omaka-an
flavor: He slept across the ridges, and every careless cut promised another terror.

name: Heaven-Rending Wind, Taguwasi
flavor: His heartbeat became thunder, and the fifth sky opened before his wind.

name: Fifth-Sky Arrowlord, Kalimangalnuk
flavor: From the fifth sky, his arrow ruled every road beneath heaven.

name: Life-Restoring Mother, Ina Nanolay
flavor: Where her living waters flowed, even fallen breath returned.

name: Mystic River Caller, Alig
flavor: She called the hidden river, and three fallen brothers rose again.

name: Fallen Sky Warrior, Talimanog
flavor: He fought beneath heaven until even the sky remembered his fall.

name: Defiant Sky Warrior, Ammani
flavor: No god stood so high that his courage would not answer.

name: Enduring Sky Warrior, Annibo
flavor: Long after strength had failed, his resolve still faced the sky.

name: Golden Gate Warden, Nagdombilan
flavor: Before the golden gate, no mortal passed without facing his judgment.

name: Moon-Stealing Wing, Ammalabukkaw
flavor: At the Sky God's command, its wings carried moonlight into captivity.

name: Captive Moon, Innawagan
flavor: Beyond the golden gate, her hope still found a path toward sunrise.

name: Sunrise-Seeking Wing, Dalewasan
flavor: Across barbed heavens, one faithful wing carried the call for rescue.

name: Shapeshifting Savior, Nagmalitong Yawa
flavor: When heaven barred the way, she became the warrior the captive needed.

name: Celestial Matriarch, Alunsina
flavor: She chose a mortal heart, and from that choice three legends were born.

name: Lifespan Carver, Sidapa
flavor: Every life rose only as high as the mark carved upon his sacred tree.

name: Seven-Year Challenger, Labaw Donggon
flavor: Seven years broke his strength, but never silenced the challenge in his blood.

name: Tarangban Voyager, Humadapnon
flavor: No poisoned sea or enchanted prison could end the voyager's return.

name: Ridge-Splitting Warrior, Dumalapdap
flavor: Where monsters guarded the road, his blade divided fear from destiny.

name: Heart-Veiled Lord, Saragnayon
flavor: His heart beat beyond his body, hidden where no ordinary blade could reach.

name: Ancestral Faithkeeper, Tamblot
flavor: He raised the old faith again, though an empire answered with fire.

name: Diwata Shrinekeeper, Pagali
flavor: When sacred images burned, he built the diwata another shrine.

name: Final-Blow Heir, Asu Mangga
flavor: He struck the weakened lord and opened the road to his father.

name: Heart-Beast Hunter, Buyung Baranungun
flavor: He hunted the beasts that carried an immortal heart.
